pressCycle.quote: Without resorting to ostentatious virtuosity, articulated phrases, accents, and lyrical lines with remarkable freedom.
…an incredible combination of sensitivity and taste.
The bravura and maturity of his playing render speechless.

bio: Austrian pianist and composer Kiron Atom Tellian is currently pursuing his bachelor’s degree at The Juilliard School in New York, studying with Maestro Sergei Babayan as a recipient of the prestigious Kovner Fellowship. Born in Vienna, he began his piano studies at the University for Music and Performing Arts Vienna (MDW) at age seven and made his orchestral debut at nine.

Tellian has garnered top prizes at international competitions across Europe, the USA, and Japan. In 2024, he won the YCA Susan Wadsworth International Auditions, receiving eight special prizes. As a composer, his works have been widely recognised; this season, he has been commissioned to write an orchestral work premiering at the Vienna Musikverein.

This season, Tellian performs at the Vienna Konzerthaus, the Viotti Festival, the Vienna Musikverein, and made his debut with the Orchestra Sinfonica di Milano in Chopin’s First Piano Concerto. Looking ahead: debuts with the San Diego Symphony, a recital at Villa Senar invited by the Rachmaninov Foundation, and his solo recital debut at Carnegie Hall.
